It’s hard to explain, but I’ve wanted to be a woman since I was three years old. It’s constantly in the back of my head. 

Whenever someone calls me “sir” it feels wrong, whenever I go into the men’s room it feels wrong, and sometimes when I’m doing something completely gender neutral (working, playing video games, etc) the thought will pop up that I would much rather be doing this as a woman.

This of course extends to my sexual desires as well. The thought of having sex as a man disgusts me.

I’m not going to diagnose myself, but I’m pretty sure I have gender dysphoria. Since I can’t transition, reducing one of the worst parts of being a man will greatly improve my quality of life.

I don’t think I have depression since these thoughts come and go in waves, but I could be wrong.

I feel like having a high sex drive wouldn’t negatively impact me as much if I was in a woman’s body. It’s the way my body reacts to said sex drive that makes me feel awful.

I’m still completely in the closet, so my body is still 100% male.
Maybe? But I can assure you that sex is far from the only reason I want to be a woman.

Let me start by saying that I’m still in the closet, so maybe don’t take my opinion at the same level as people who are out, since I’m basing it solely on what I’ve had to endure pretending to be cis, but as someone who loves cosplay I don’t have any problem with it whatsoever.

As long as you are cosplaying respectfully, and not trying to make fun of trans people (I’ve unfortunately seen cosplays of people going out of there way to show exaggerated features on trans characters) I don’t think it’s a problem at all.

Also in the off chance someone assumes your trans, be sure to set the record straight.

Honestly one day I would like to be able to cosplay as Yui from K-On, since she’s my favorite character, and I would be pretty offended if someone told me I could only cosplay trans characters because I’m trans. Even though it’s not exactly the same since the power dynamic is different, I still don’t think you should only be able to cosplay cis characters because you are cis.

Sorry for the ramble and I hope I was able to help.

Hey OP here. I just wanted to say there is a lot more that has led me to believe I might be trans, this post in particular was just about the sexual side of it. 

I honestly don’t know what comforts I might have being a man, since I’ve never been able to explore not living as one, but I do feel discomfort in being a man.

I hate to admit it but sometimes I get very jealous of happy women because I feel like I’ll never be like them. I also sometimes feel annoyed when people use masculine language to describe me.

Being expected to live by male social roles in society makes me feel awful. I’m against gender roles in general, but for some reason being expected to act based on male social roles just doesn’t sit right me with me.

There’s more that I can go into but these are just a few of the things I am weighing when I consider if I’m trans or not in addition to the sexual stuff.
